source.behavior: Reset the page to 1 and re-read the persisted WordPress page projection with search, selected site, status and page size; no external WordPress mutation.

implementation.details: A canonical Apply filters form is wired into the existing Global Pages management grid; its query key carries applied filter parameters and a revision to force a new authoritative read on repeated Apply. Selection is cleared upon apply, while existing draft/trash actions preserve their real execution path.

security.tenant_isolation: Site and ContentItem Eloquent models carry tenant global scopes and the active tenant is resolved by tenant.context.
security.direct_site_id: Validated tenant-scoped Site::findOrFail rejects foreign tenant or unavailable site with 404.
security.permission: content.view on the read endpoint; tenant.view for site options; content.edit remains mandatory for existing mutation controls.
security.failure: HTTP errors are displayed, no optimistic success or fabricated local rows; read-only filtering never mutates WordPress.
security.explicit_no_leaks: No caller-provided tenant ownership, provider credential, site secrets, or new external mutation.

focus: source-to-React binding and exact operation ID
